verdict.rationale: Mastra Code documents a browser provider option that gives the agent browser tools, a first-party way for the assistant to interact with a running web app. Nothing documents actual debugging of a live app, such as inspecting console logs, network traffic, DOM state or runtime errors. MCP configs and custom tools are building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented live-app debugging workflow, console/network/runtime inspection, details of what the browser tools can do, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug a live running web application directly from my coding assistant

citations.quote: Browser provider; when set the agent gains browser tools
